properties.description: Migrated from DataStage Server Job 'J139_Transbk_Mcf_Extraccion_Hash' (JobType=0, DateModified=2021-10-28). Reads lookup/reference data from Teradata EDW (LDM stage, Context=1=read mode, multi-output) and writes 10 hash files (.H) to $PathHash for use as reference tables in Cuentas/Tarjetas transformations. Hash files: Product, MaxCardId, Statement_Cycle_Type, Asset_Liability_Type, Balance_Category_Type, System_Abuse_Type, Account_Card_Income_Type, Feature_Cuentas, Acct_Relationship_Type, Contract_Party_Role_Type. In ADF: hash files are ELIMINATED and replaced by ADF Mapping Data Flow cache sinks or Lookup activities reading directly from Teradata.

activities.name: Read_LDM_Hash_Data
activities.description: Read reference/lookup data from Teradata LDM. Maps to DataStage LDM stage (TeradataConnector, Context=1=read, 4 output links: Lnk_Bci_Ptc, Lnk_Tab, Lnk_Tab_352, Lnk_EIH_Rut). Output populates hash files for downstream lookup use.

PathHash.description: Hash files path (ADLS). Maps to $PathHash. In ADF hash files are cache sinks.
